dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh? What kind of place is that?

dialogues.speaker: Efremova
dialogues.text: I don't know. I haven't been back in a long time. The House of Hesperides without Larisa...

dialogues.speaker: Efremova
dialogues.text: Back then, I didn't like its new master, the Snegovik who called herself the owner.

dialogues.speaker: Efremova
dialogues.text: But beyond that place... I've grown tired of the outside world. Now I just want to go back.
